##Load packages
```{r}
install.packages(c("tidyverse", "dplyr", "ggplot2", "writexl", "egg", "stringr", "lubridate"))

library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(writexl)
library(egg)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)


```

##Data Cleaning
```{r}
getwd()

raw_bee_data <- read.csv("./data/raw_data/CABR_specimens_V4.csv",header=TRUE)

clean_bee_data <- raw_bee_data%>%
  mutate(date_clean = mdy(Date),
        month = month(date_clean),
        day = day(date_clean), 
        year = year(date_clean),
        across(where(is.character), ~na_if(.x, "")))


# Keep ONLY rows where either or NA
#NO LAT OR LONG?
##nolatlong <- clean_bee_data %>%   filter(is.na(Latitude) | is.na(Longitude)) <-- creates whole new data set

##keeps it within the same data set of "clean_bee_data"
clean_bee_data <- clean_bee_data %>% mutate(missinglatlong = is.na(Latitude) | is.na(Longitude))
###filtering it here (filter is default true) will give you true, but best practice to write == True
missinglatlong <- clean_bee_data %>% filter(missinglatlong == TRUE)

#NO GENUS OR SPECIES?
clean_bee_data <- clean_bee_data %>% mutate(missinggenusspecies = is.na(Genus) | is.na(Species))
missinggenusspecies <- clean_bee_data %>% filter(missinggenusspecies == TRUE)

clean_bee_data <- clean_bee_data %>% mutate(missingmethodplant = is.na(Method...Plant))
missingmethodplant <- clean_bee_data %>% filter(missingmethodplant == TRUE)


# SPECIES CHECKLIST
clean_bee_data <- clean_bee_data %>% mutate(oldscientificname = paste0(Genus,"_",Subgenus,"_",Species))

unique_old_species_list <- unique(clean_bee_data$oldscientificname)

view(unique_old_species_list)


```
